entries.effect: a key is made from a name the host accepts (no ASCII punctuation but _, $, +, <, =, >, ^, `, | and ~, and no character outside ASCII) and four flags; a name it refuses gives nil, from either initializer, and init raises. Keys are equal when their names are equal, and to a string of that name; copy gives an equal key with the same flags; description reads <CSCustomAttributeKey:ADDRESS NAME with no closing angle bracket; the key codes and decodes its name and flags
entries.source: the macOS CoreSpotlight framework of the host (tests/backports/host/corespotlight-customkey, identical to the port's 168 lines, with a planted control the same comparison tells apart); the rendered header of CSSearchableItemAttributeSet.h from the 26.2 SDK for the surface
